title: Cloud Configuration Drift
intent: Problem: running infrastructure no longer matches code, approvals or the recovery environment
brief: Out-of-band fixes, console changes and partial applies separate running state from declared state. Covers detection, drift age, which drift matters, reconciliation ownership and proof of restored parity.

title: Identity Access Drift
intent: Problem: effective access has moved away from intended policy
brief: Policy looks intact while exclusions, guests, group nesting and application consents widen effective access. Covers measuring effective versus intended access, exception expiry and verified reduction.

title: Stale Privileged Access
intent: Problem: privileged assignments persist after the need has ended
brief: Standing administrators, unused roles, former project access and unrotated emergency accounts. Covers usage-based identification, removal ownership, re-verification after removal and preventing re-accumulation.

title: Security Remediation Backlog
intent: Problem: open findings exceed remediation capacity and age past agreed windows
brief: A backlog is a threshold breach that has been normalised. Covers reducing the set to reachable, exploited and consequential exposure, ownership assignment, age thresholds and exception governance.

title: Unverified Vulnerability Closure
intent: Problem: findings are marked closed without evidence that the exposure is gone
brief: Tickets close on a deployed fix; exposure returns on rebuild, scale-out or reverted configuration. Covers closure criteria, re-test evidence, regression detection and reopening rules.

title: Data Pipeline Freshness Failure
intent: Problem: data arrived late or stopped arriving and consumers were not told
brief: Pipelines succeeded while data aged. Covers consumer-side freshness measurement, lag sources, downstream impact tracing, backfill verification and freshness thresholds by consumer.

title: Schema Change Production Impact
intent: Problem: an upstream schema or semantic change broke or silently corrupted downstream consumers
brief: A column changes meaning or type and downstream systems keep running on wrong data. Covers contract enforcement, compatibility checks, blast-radius mapping through lineage and verified downstream correction.

title: Cloud Cost Anomaly
intent: Problem: an unexpected cost increase must be attributed, corrected and prevented
brief: Detection is rarely the gap; attribution and owned correction are. Covers time to attribute, allocation coverage, correction ownership, verification in billing data and preventing recurrence.

title: High Change Failure Rate
intent: Problem: too many releases cause incidents, rollbacks or rework
brief: Release risk shows up as failed changes and unplanned rework. Covers honest measurement, failure classification, gate effectiveness, exposure control and the threshold at which release pace must change. Canonical page for release risk.
